name: BrainyPress
author: BrainyPress

sections.description:
BrainyPress is an automation tool designed to streamline content creation for WordPress using the Google Gemini 2.0 API. It leverages Real-Time Grounding (Google Search) to fetch current news and data before generating articles, ensuring content is relevant and up-to-date.

Additionally, the plugin includes native Twitter (X) integration to automatically share posts upon publication.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Grounding: Uses Google Search to retrieve the latest information for article generation, suitable for news, tech, and finance topics.
  • Post Status Control: Choose to publish articles immediately or save them as a Draft for manual review.
  • Twitter (X) Auto-Post: Automatically tweets the post title and link to your connected Twitter account using OAuth 1.0a.
  • Anti-Repetition Logic: Includes smart topic handling to prevent generating duplicate content on similar prompts.
  • Neubrutalism Dashboard: A clean, high-contrast interface for managing API keys and automation schedules.

External Services Disclosure

In compliance with WordPress Plugin Directory Guideline 6, this plugin requires the use of third-party external services to function. No data is sent to these services unless you provide your own API keys.

1. Google Gemini API (by Google)
* Service: Artificial Intelligence content generation and search grounding.
* Data Sent: Your topic prompts, keywords, and current date.
* Purpose: To generate the article text and perform live web searches.
* Links: Google Privacy Policy | Gemini API Terms

2. Twitter / X API (by X Corp)
* Service: Social media automation.
* Data Sent: The published post title, permalink, and hashtags.
* Purpose: To automatically tweet your new content to your followers.
* Links: Twitter Privacy Policy | Developer Terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the brainypress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the BrainyPress menu in your dashboard.
  4. API Setup: Enter your personal Google Gemini API Key and (optional) Twitter Developer keys.
  5. Create Order: Select a category, enter a prompt, and choose Publish or Draft.
  6. Run: Click “Run Now” to generate instantly or set a daily schedule.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use its own API keys?

No. For your security and control, you must provide your own API keys for both Google Gemini and Twitter. This ensures you have full ownership of your data and usage limits.

How does “Real-Time Grounding” work?

We use Gemini’s built-in Google Search_retrieval tool. When the AI generates a post, it performs a live search query to gather the most recent information before writing.

Is any user data tracked?

No. BrainyPress does not track user behavior or collect personal data. All API communications happen directly between your WordPress server and the respective service providers (Google/Twitter).
